selection_policy.objective: Highest average net R after a hypothetical 0.05R round-trip cost

assumptions.entry: Signal-bar close; stop checks start next candle.
assumptions.max_hold: 6, 12, 24, or 36 M5 bars, then close if SL was not hit.
assumptions.position_management: One open position per setup at a time.
assumptions.costs: Sensitivity deductions from 0 to 0.10 initial-risk R; not broker-specific. Bid-only data excludes actual spread.
assumptions.test_period: Diagnostic only; prior analysis has inspected this period.
